scientific_question: Can the P11 short-utterance specialist recover short-file errors while the unchanged P0 CAM++ control protects long-file Known/OOD performance?

disclosed_prior_analysis.what_was_observed: Descriptive fixed bins and per-bin model errors were inspected before this preregistration.
disclosed_prior_analysis.selection_firewall: No routed prediction or routed aggregate metric has been computed. The 8.0-second cutoff is fixed by the ordinary teacher/control view duration in the already-preregistered P11 protocol, not selected by maximizing a Fold-0 bin score.

inputs.duration_measurement: decoded WAV header frames divided by sample rate

locked_router.decision: direct argmax of the selected 447-way probability vector

gate.passing_action: Authorize a separate preregistration and training of Fold-1/Fold-2 short specialists for the same fixed 8-second router; do not build a submission yet.
gate.failing_action: Close P11/P12 duration routing and move to a genuinely different condition-robust frontend or augmentation hypothesis.

later_fold_contract_if_authorized.specialist_recipe: P11 teacher-student recipe with the matching fold's P0 Raw checkpoint as teacher and warm start
later_fold_contract_if_authorized.final_aggregation: LME20 across the three fold-specific routed probability vectors

prohibitions: No duration cutoff sweep or same-Fold router selection.
No probability blend between P0 and P11.
No threshold, epoch, LME power, or submission tuning with the leaderboard.
Fold0 alone cannot authorize a ZIP or leaderboard upload.
